name: model
description: Where the solution is (day, period, period length), the mass accounting (total, per period, per drawpoint-day), the global fragmentation and mass-balance limits, and the solve-output objects.
notes: `massflow.markerfraglimit.lower/upper` and `massflow.massbalance.lower/upper` are the FISH side of the `massflow initialize markerfraglimit-*` and `massbalance-*` keywords; both are readable and writable.
`massflow.mass.DpDay` is spelled in mixed case by the binary. FISH is case-insensitive, so the manual's `massflow.mass.dpday` resolves to it.

intrinsics.name: massflow.day
intrinsics.description: Get the day for the current state.

intrinsics.name: massflow.mass.DpDay
intrinsics.description: Get the mass extracted for a specific drawpoint in a specific day.

intrinsics.name: massflow.mass.period
intrinsics.description: Get the mass extracted in a specific period.

intrinsics.name: massflow.period
intrinsics.description: Get the period for the current state.
